<article title="Shipping times and options">
Standard shipping arrives in three to six business days after the order leaves our warehouse. Express shipping arrives in one to two business days. The estimate shown at checkout counts from the shipping date, not the order date.

We ship to all fifty states and to Canada. Delivery estimates to Canada add two to four business days for customs processing, and duties are collected by the carrier at delivery.

Weather and peak seasons can extend delivery times. If a package is more than five business days past its estimate, contact us and we will trace it with the carrier.

</article>

Customer first name: Jamal
<request>
delivery marked complete but nothing arrived
the carrier says the package was delivered yesterday but there is nothing at my door or with my neighbors.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Jamal,

Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. Our shipping information says that if a package is more than five business days past its estimated delivery, we can trace it with the carrier. The article doesn't cover what happens when a carrier marks a package delivered but it can't be found, so a specialist will follow up with you on next steps for this situation.

To help them look into it, please reply with your order number and the delivery address on the order.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
